newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil cuts oil output at Statfjord.
newsitem.headline: Statoil cuts oil output at Statfjord.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Tuesday it had reduced oil production at the Statfjord B and C platforms as bad weather prevented offshore crude loadings in the North Sea for a third day.
It said further reductions in output were possible on the Statfjord A and Gullfaks C installations by Tuesday evening.
"There are still no loadings. We are hoping for a weather window tonight but the forecast for tomorrow is bad with very high winds," Statoil spokeswoman Nina Steihaug said.
Crude output at Statfjord B was cut by 10,000 cubic metres per day, or roughly 63,000 barrels per day (bpd), from around midnight. The platform normally pumps 24,000 cubic metres per day.

Total throughput at Statfjord C, which also processes oil from nearby Statfjord North and East satellites, was reduced by 15-20,000 cubic metres to between 30-35,000 cubic metres per day, Steihaug said.
"Statfjord A is normal at the moment but we may start reducing production tonight," she said. "Gullfaks is also normal for now, but Gullfaks C may be reduced from this evening."
